# What Cuebot does not support

C# methods for a **Run C# code** step. See [C# methods](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run C# code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-csharp-step.png)

## TwitchClientId

Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot never gives its Twitch login details to scripts. Reading it stops your code with a "not supported" error.

```csharp
string TwitchClientId { get; }
```

**Example**

```csharp
string clientId = CPH.TwitchClientId;
```

## TwitchOAuthToken

Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot never gives its Twitch login token to scripts. Reading it stops your code with a "not supported" error.

```csharp
string TwitchOAuthToken { get; }
```

**Example**

```csharp
string token = CPH.TwitchOAuthToken;
```

## TwitchGetChannelPointsUsedByUserId

Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot counts reward redemptions, not how many channel points a viewer spent. It only writes a warning in the log.

```csharp
long TwitchGetChannelPointsUsedByUserId(string userId)
```

**Gives back:** Always 0.

**Example**

```csharp
long used = CPH.TwitchGetChannelPointsUsedByUserId("12345678");
CPH.LogInfo($"Points used: {used}");
```

## TwitchGetBitsDonatedByUserId

Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot does not keep a total of the Bits each viewer cheered. It only writes a warning in the log.

```csharp
long TwitchGetBitsDonatedByUserId(string userId)
```

**Gives back:** Always 0.

**Example**

```csharp
long bits = CPH.TwitchGetBitsDonatedByUserId("12345678");
CPH.LogInfo($"Bits: {bits}");
```

## SetChannelGameById

Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot sets the Twitch category by its name, not its id. It only writes a warning in the log. Use SetChannelGame with the category name instead.

```csharp
bool SetChannelGameById(string gameId)
```

**Gives back:** Always false.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.SetChannelGameById("509658");
CPH.LogInfo($"Changed: {ok}");
```

## AddQuoteForTrovo

Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot has no Trovo connection. It only writes a warning in the log.

```csharp
int AddQuoteForTrovo(string userId, string quote, bool captureGame = false)
```

**Gives back:** Always -1.

**Example**

```csharp
int quote = CPH.AddQuoteForTrovo("12345", "Best stream ever!");
CPH.LogInfo($"Quote number: {quote}");
```

## SendTrovoMessage

Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot has no Trovo connection. It only writes a warning in the log and sends nothing.

```csharp
void SendTrovoMessage(string message, bool useBot = true, bool fallback = true)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.SendTrovoMessage("Hello Trovo!");
```

## TrovoGetBroadcaster

Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot has no Trovo connection. It only writes a warning in the log.

```csharp

```

**Gives back:** Always null (nothing).

## GetTrovoUserVar

Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot has no Trovo connection. It only writes a warning in the log.

```csharp
T? GetTrovoUserVar<T>(string userName, string varName, bool persisted = true)
```

**Gives back:** Always the empty default (like 0).

**Example**

```csharp

CPH.LogInfo($"Points: {points}");
```
